text:
maya (Platform): Heads-up — we saw a tenant hit primary model saturation and the console auto-switched them to a smaller variant, but the responses dropped quality. Want to discuss safer automatic fallbacks.
jevon (Runtime): ugh. do we know why the smaller variant produced worse outputs? incompatible tokenizer/temperature defaults?
liu (SRE): based on logs, KV cache miss rate spiked during the switch. Also saw longer tail latencies on the fallback nodes.
amy (Product): from a UX POV we need a clearer rule: either fail open with reduced quality + notify, or queue/429 depending on tenant tier. Mixing silently is bad.
maya (Platform): proposal: introduce a per-tenant "fallback_profile" with three modes: "graceful-queue", "fallback-compatible-only", "allow-hetero-fallback". default stays "fallback-compatible-only". thoughts?
jevon (Runtime): +1 for the three modes. We should enforce compatibility by model architecture/tokenizer and min-likelihood threshold. Suggest a cheap offline check: run a 30-sample regression eval when registering a variant and store a compatibility score.
liu (SRE): also add circuit breaker by sustained latency increase and a short cool-down so we don't oscillate every minute.
amy (Product): console UX: show a banner when a tenant is using a fallback and expose the active mode. Allow admins to toggle to queue-only for paid tiers.
maya (Platform): here's a draft API payload for tenant policy:

```json
{
  "fallback_profile": "fallback-compatible-only",
  "compatibility_threshold": 0.85,
  "max_queue_ms": 2000,
  "notify_on_fallback": true
}
```

maya (Platform): ops-bot: prod-deploy status?
ops-bot: deploy completed to staging at 2024-08-14T15:02:12Z :white_check_mark:
jevon (Runtime): next steps for runtime: (1) wire compatibility scores into routing decision, (2) implement short-term circuit breaker + cooldown, (3) telemetry: emit tags: `fallback_mode`, `compat_score`, `primary_saturation_pct`.
liu (SRE): telemetry note: please ensure events include tenant id hashed, and sample token-level latency + top-1 model id so we can correlate quality regressions.
amy (Product): can we also add a console chart showing fallback_rate by tenant tier and by region? Sales will ask.
maya (Platform): agreed. I'll open a playbook doc with config schema and a safe rollout plan: start with staging, then opt-in for a handful of low-risk tenants, then 2-week canary. pinging @amy for sign-off before canary.
amy (Product): sign-off pending regression eval threshold definition. if compatibility_score >= 0.9, I'm fine with auto-fallback for free tier; otherwise queue-first.
jevon (Runtime): I'll prototype the compatibility harness today — will post a short thread with eval samples.
maya (Platform): thanks — keeping this contained and observable is the main goal. :thumbsup:
